versions.name: Camping
versions.description: Sleep out for twenty nights, pitch and care for tents, pack for warm and cold weather, cook for your patrol over a stove, and take on a mountain hike, snow camp, or rappel along the way.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
